primary_claim: LLMs cannot reliably produce self-generated counterfactual explanations that are both valid and minimal: in standard prompting they generate nearly perfectly valid but non-minimal counterfactuals, while under minimal-prompting the counterfactuals are rarely valid, revealing a validity-minimality trade-off across 7 LLMs and 3 tabular datasets.

effect.metric: validity and minimality of self-generated counterfactual explanations

stated_future_work: Develop new learning objectives that incentivise models to know about their own behaviour; the authors state they are currently exploring this.
Carefully evaluate models on situational-awareness benchmarks to check whether new self-modelling training objectives cause undesirable generalisations.
quote: In short, models don't know their own decision boundaries.
